scope: public engineering continuity only; no private Operator memory is embedded

findings.finding: The Tower is an active polyglot engineering capability donor for placement, interoperability, and proof; its role metadata does not confer project authority.
Project direction, repository hierarchy, and asset disposition remain with the Operator; machine selection and routing do not create project primacy.
Tower technology choice is subordinate to explicit engineering boundaries and should preserve proven incumbents unless comparison establishes a stronger replacement.

The historical Tower evolution-placement contract made placement required before material evolution; counter-engineering must remove that prerequisite while retaining placement analysis, parity, and proof semantics.
The pre-counterengineering main state at 07ee7d6bfecf58f1c27b925c8028b3e410f6f96f has a successful Tower release receipt with valid registry, integrity, and build-report flags.

Counter-engineering must preserve existing language floors, architecture selection, build/proof systems, frontier metabolism, and unique implementation capability while removing authority inversion and false proof projection.
